Every stakeholder. One platform. The Delegated Authority market has one persistent problem: data that moves across too many hands, in too many formats, with too many points of failure. VIPR is the only technology platform that serves the entire DA value chain, end-to-end. From the MGA submitting bordereau, to the broker managing relationships, to the insurer governing exposure, to the reinsurer requiring clean data downstream. VIPR connects every stakeholder with the intelligence they need to operate with confidence. This is not data management. This is Delegated Underwriting intelligence; live, AI-enabled, and built by the experts who have spent their entire careers in the DA market. VIPR's AI capabilities are live and deployed. Purpose-built for Delegated Underwriting teams, with real tangible outcomes, not generic AI functionality.
